issues.finding: curl -Lo runtime.nupkg https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/$runtimePackBase/$anyVersion && unzip -q runtime.nupkg -d runtime-extracted && dotnet-symbol --symbols -o symbols-out runtime-extracted/runt
issues.explanation: Data is being sent to an external URL. This could be legitimate telemetry or data exfiltration. Manual review is recommended.
issues.remediation: Verify the destination URL is trusted and necessary. Remove or replace with documented APIs. Ensure no secrets, tokens, or PII are transmitted.

issues.explanation: Code or instructions that leak agent conversation context to external services, potentially exposing sensitive user interactions.
issues.remediation: Remove any code that sends prompts, responses, or session data externally. Preserve user privacy; never exfiltrate conversation content.
